cd /tmp; C=/Users/ray/Coding/magic-agent-video-generator/V2/bench/mcp/fleet/chat.mjs; ID=s4.old.dumper.G36b
BASE='Clean modern plant shop sale ad. Palette: deep forest green, soft sage green and warm cream only. Lush leafy indoor plants (monstera, fern fronds, pothos) as decoration around the edges, never behind text. Text sits on a plain flat cream panel with dark green bold sans-serif letters, high contrast, large and crisp, correctly spelled, exactly these five lines and no other text: "Fern House" (logo/brand name), "Weekend Plant Sale" (biggest headline), "20% off all indoor plants", "Saturday & Sunday", "Visit 24 Willow Lane" (address, large and bold, clearly legible).'
node $C $ID generate_image "$(jq -nc --arg p "$BASE Square 1:1 layout: plants framing the corners, centered text stack on cream panel." '{name:"Fern House 1:1",image_count:1,model:"qwen-image-2.1",aspect_ratio:"1:1",resolution:"640px",style:{prompt:$p}}')" &
node $C $ID generate_image "$(jq -nc --arg p "$BASE Tall vertical 9:16 story layout: leafy plants across the top and bottom, text stacked vertically in the middle with generous spacing, each line big and wide across the frame." '{name:"Fern House 9:16",image_count:1,model:"qwen-image-2.1",aspect_ratio:"9:16",resolution:"640px",style:{prompt:$p}}')" &
node $C $ID generate_image "$(jq -nc --arg p "$BASE Wide horizontal 16:9 banner layout: leafy plants on the right third, text block on the left two-thirds on cream, left-aligned, headline large." '{name:"Fern House 16:9",image_count:1,model:"qwen-image-2.1",aspect_ratio:"16:9",resolution:"640px",style:{prompt:$p}}')" &
wait
